partial_scope: These categories can overlap in principle; the actual intersection count is recorded separately.
limitation: Complete means all planned numerical sections/intervals were constructed. It does not certify a globally non-self-intersecting material boundary, CAD tessellation error, physical printability, manufacturing force or thermal behaviour.
omission_envelope_scope: AABB XY area times unresolved height bounds only omitted-height contribution, not total numerical or manufacturing error.
initial_harness_failure: event-final-01 was stopped after a relative frozen-engine path caused worker import failures before section calculation; event-final-02 resolved paths and ran all targets.
